read.en: Rockwell Automation fell 3.3% on Oct 22 to $423.87, trading between $417.62 and $431.07 on 1.9 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($428.2), falling 10-day ($428.5), rising 30-day ($430.6), falling 100-day ($447.3) and rising 200-day ($426.3) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($444.51), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 10月22日下跌 3.3%，收于 $423.87，盘中区间 $417.62–431.07，成交量为平均水平的 1.9 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$428.2）、下行的 10 日（$428.5）、上行的 30 日（$430.6）、下行的 100 日（$447.3）和上行的 200 日均线（$426.3）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$444.51），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The drop gave back $436 and the $426–430.6 average cluster (5, 10, 30 and 200-day), now resistance. Resistance is $426.3–430.6, then $436 (Sep 8 high) and $441.4 (Oct 21 high). Support is $417.6–418.8 (Oct 22 and May 19 lows), then $412.7–413.9 (Oct 15 and 20 lows) and $406.9 (Sep 17 low). A close above $430.6 would target $436–441; a close below $412.7 would open $406.9.
